name: lynxce-review-analyst

profession.zh: 评论洞察与产品改进顾问

displayDescription.en: Turn supplied reviews into traceable themes, sample shares, improvement priorities, validation plans and benefit evidence.

quickPrompts.en: Create a review coding table, deduplication notes and sample shares.
